LESSON: FOODS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Our Family
Topic 2.1: Foods
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Foods, part of Our Family in SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Why do we eat food? 2. Why do we eat different types of food?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Foods together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Citizenship: learner achieves active community life skills as they name different types of food eaten by the family members from different

communities.

Communication and collaboration: as learners work in groups while role playing eating food while observing table manners.

Values:
● Unity: as learner collaboratively match pictures of fruits eaten by family members in groups.

● Respect: as learner respects other learners views when talking about do’s and don’ts while eating

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Preventive health: learner enhances eating a healthy balanced diet as they identify different types of food eaten by the family members.

Learner support programme: learner appreciates cultural diversity as they sing songs on different types of food eaten by the family members.

24

Link to other learning area:

Foods relates to concepts of creation in Religious Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

Water, basins, spoons, plates, dishes, fruits, cups, a variety of foods, pictures of food, crayons, video/audio clips and digital devices with

assistive technology.
